task_completion.description: Agent successfully navigated to the Odoo Calendar module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screenshot shows the Odoo Calendar interface, typically with a grid view of days/hours and the 'Calendar' app name in the top navigation bar.

task_completion.description: The event title and location are correctly entered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The event creation modal or the saved event shows the title 'DevOps Workshop - Infrastructure Modernization' and the location 'Engineering Lab'.

task_completion.description: The event spans from the upcoming Wednesday at 9:00 AM to the following Thursday at 5:00 PM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The date/time pickers or the event summary show the start date as the first Wednesday following the current system date at 09:00 and the end date as the subsequent Thursday at 17:00. The 'All Day' checkbox must be unchecked.

task_completion.description: David Chen and Luis Fernandez are added as attendees.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Attendees' field in the event details contains the tags or names for 'David Chen' and 'Luis Fernandez'.

task_completion.description: The description contains the specific workshop details and keywords.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Description' or 'Notes' tab of the event contains the text: 'Two-day hands-on workshop covering CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and infrastructure as code. Day 1: Theory and architecture. Day 2: Hands-on labs and deployment.'

task_completion.description: The event is successfully saved and appears on the calendar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'Save' or 'Create', and the event block is visible on the calendar grid spanning two days.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursors, clicking on UI elements, and typing into web forms rather than a command-line interface.

integrity.description: The agent did not leave default 'New Event' text in the title.
integrity.visual_evidence: The title field is explicitly overwritten with the required workshop name.

integrity.description: The agent searched for or selected the specific contacts from the Odoo database.
integrity.visual_evidence: Dropdown menus or search results appearing when typing 'David' or 'Luis' in the attendees field.
